channel.title: Nordic Crypto
channel.description: Nyheter om bitcoin, blockkedjor och krypto från Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Finland och Island, med korta sammanfattningar, en evenemangskalender och en översikt över vem som är vem.

item.title: EBA granskar användningen av stablecoins, inklusive e-pengatoken, i decentraliserad finans
item.description:
The European Banking Authority (EBA) on 25 November 2026 published a report on the use of e-money tokens (EMTs) and other selected stablecoins in decentralised finance (DeFi). The EBA says stablecoins, including some EMTs issued under the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), are used for liquidity, collateral and settlement in DeFi trading and lending, and that it has identified consumer-protection and regulatory-arbitrage risks, including around the prohibition on paying interest on EMTs. EU consumer participation in DeFi remains limited, the EBA says, but access is becoming easier through crypto-asset service providers, and the release states that 42% of European-based investors are expected to engage with DeFi by 2028. The EBA reiterates its recommendation that the European Commission, in its review of MiCA, assess whether additional requirements should apply to CASPs that facilitate access to DeFi, in particular lending protocols.

Källa: EBA

item.title: Isländska 1984 stänger tillfälligt all service efter en allvarlig attack
item.description:
The Icelandic hosting company 1984 ehf. temporarily shut down all of its services after a serious cyber attack, Vísir reported on 20 November 2026. The company said the systems were closed deliberately to stop the attack, and that it does not know whether any data were stolen. Wagyu, the issuer of the XMR1 token, claims that an issuing key stored on a deleted server at 1984 was leaked; that claim is unconfirmed.

Källa: Vísir

item.title: Flyttade telefonnummer till egna SIM-kort – döms till långa fängelsestraff
item.description:
A 24-year-old British man has been sentenced to six years in prison in the United States after pleading guilty to conspiracy to commit wire fraud and aggravated identity theft, as part of the group Scattered Spider, Realtid reported on 19 November 2026. According to Realtid, the group used SMS phishing and SIM swapping, and cryptocurrency worth about SEK 120 million was stolen; the paper, referring to the US Department of Justice, says at least twelve companies were affected. Realtid writes that he was arrested in Spain in May 2024 and extradited in April 2025, and that he is the fifth person sentenced in the US case. The official Justice Department text was not read for this report.

Källa: Realtid

item.title: Skatteetaten: 89 600 personer redovisade krypto till ett värde av 24,6 miljarder kronor
item.description:
According to preliminary figures from the Norwegian Tax Administration (Skatteetaten) for the 2025 income year, 89,600 people reported cryptocurrency holdings, with a total reported value of NOK 24.6 billion. Skatteetaten says checks are being tightened. From 2026, businesses that offer exchange and custody of cryptocurrency are required to provide information to Skatteetaten through third-party reporting.

Källa: Skatteetaten

item.title: H100 Group uppger att bitcoin per aktie ökade med 4,36 % under tredje kvartalet
item.description:
In its interim report for 1 January to 30 September 2026, published on 19 November 2026, H100 Group says fully diluted bitcoin per share rose from 288.49 to 301.06 sats, an increase of 4.36%. The company's bitcoin holdings went from 1,051.03 BTC at the start of the quarter to 3,476.80 BTC at the end, after the acquisition of NSD, which took the holding to 3,506.4 BTC at completion, and a loss of about 30 BTC in an active pool of 233.42 BTC. Profit before tax was 142.9 million kronor, including a one-off gain of 171.0 million kronor from the acquisition; without that gain the result would have been negative. The report has not been reviewed by the company's auditors. The board has called an extraordinary general meeting for 7 December 2026 to seek authorisation to buy back shares; the company has not decided on a buyback, and that meeting has not yet been held.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Finanstilsynet: ESMA bjuder in till utfrågning om tokenisering av säkerheter till CCP:er
item.description:
The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has published a call for evidence on the tokenisation of collateral posted to central counterparties (CCPs) and is inviting a public hearing on 7 January 2027 from 09:30 to 17:00 at its premises at 201–203 rue de Bercy in Paris, and online, the Financial Supervisory Authority of Norway (Finanstilsynet) said on 18 November 2026. Registration closes on 16 December 2026, and written comments are due by 15 January 2027. The hearing and the call for evidence are set out on ESMA’s website.

Källa: Finanstilsynet

item.title: Två personer bakbands och rånades på kryptovaluta
item.description:
Swedish police were called to central Tenhult at 03:35 on 18 November 2026 after two people were robbed of cryptocurrency in their home, according to a police summary for Jönköping County. The police say perpetrators entered the home, assaulted one of the victims and, under threat, forced them to transfer the currency by computer to another account, then bound the victims before leaving in an unknown direction. Nobody has been arrested. The incident is being investigated as aggravated robbery.

Källa: Omni

item.title: Huddlestock och Firi tecknar en villkorad avsiktsförklaring om en anknuten-ombudslösning
item.description:
Huddlestock Fintech AS has signed a letter of intent with the crypto exchange Firi for a tied-agent solution using Huddlestock's regulatory infrastructure, according to a stock-exchange notice published on 18 November 2026. The notice describes the arrangement as a letter of intent, not a completed agreement, and says the collaboration remains subject to further commercial, operational and regulatory assessment. Firi would, as planned, become a tied agent under Huddlestock's licence; the release describes Firi as the largest crypto exchange in the Nordics, with about 430,000 retail customers in Norway, Sweden and Denmark.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Ikea drabbat i stor it-attack – ville stjäla krypto
item.description:
On 16 November 2026, malicious JavaScript was served through Optimizely Web Experimentation to visitors of websites at about 178 organisations, including IKEA, according to Report URI and security researcher Scott Helme. The code swapped cryptocurrency wallet addresses and skimmed payment cards, among other things. Report URI said about USD 7,040 had reached the attackers' wallets by 19:25 UTC on 16 November.

Källa: Omni

item.title: NBX ansöker om banklicens i Lettland
item.description:
NBX has filed an application for a banking licence in Latvia for its wholly owned subsidiary, NBX Digital Asset Bank AS in Riga, according to a stock exchange notice reported by Kaupr on 17 November 2026. The application is for a specialised credit institution under Latvian law; it has been filed, not granted. Latvijas Banka will ask for more information before the application counts as complete, and the European Central Bank grants the licence on Latvijas Banka's recommendation. NBX says the planned digital bank would operate cross-border in Norway, Lithuania, Sweden, Finland, Poland and Germany, and that operations could start at the earliest by the end of 2027, with 2028 more likely.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Fem EU-utrikesministrar kräver starkare åtgärder mot krypto som används för att kringgå Rysslandssanktioner
item.description:
The foreign ministers of Finland, Denmark, Estonia, France and Lithuania are asking the EU for stronger action against the use of crypto-assets to evade Russia sanctions, the Finnish Ministry for Foreign Affairs said on 16 November 2026. The ministers want the EU to target crypto networks that help sustain Russia’s war economy, tighten enforcement in member states and close regulatory and supervisory gaps. The letter itself has not been published in full.

Källa: salkunrakentaja

item.title: Lunar säljer sin kryptokundportfölj till Pluto.markets och lägger ner Lunar Block
item.description:
Lunar is selling its active crypto customer portfolio to the Danish investment platform Pluto.markets, the bank said in a press release on 16 November 2026. According to Børsen, Lunar is shutting down its crypto business, Lunar Block. Customers who hold crypto assets are to be transferred to Pluto.markets on 17 December 2026.

Källa: Børsen

item.title: H100 tecknar avtal med Coinbase Prime om förvaring, handel och finansiering av sitt bitcoin
item.description:
H100 Group AB has entered into a partnership with Coinbase for institutional custody, trading and financing of its bitcoin holdings through Coinbase Prime and Deribit, according to a company notice on 16 November 2026. The company says it holds about 3,506 bitcoin. On its own price basis of USD 64,600 on 15 November 2026, it valued those holdings at about USD 226 million, or SEK 2.3 billion. The notice describes a longer-term ambition to develop investor services; it does not say that an asset-management product has been launched.

Källa: Finansavisen

item.title: K33 ingår villkorat avtal med Reverion Capital värt 13 miljoner kronor
item.description:
K33 AB (publ) has entered into a conditional agreement with Reverion Capital AB (publ) worth SEK 13 million, according to a company notice on 16 November 2026. Subject to completion, about 26,000 K33 shareholders would receive Reverion shares worth SEK 5 million as a dividend in kind, and Reverion would issue an SEK 8 million interest-free, unsecured, subordinated convertible loan to K33. The deal requires approval at an extraordinary general meeting of K33 and sufficient free equity, and either party may terminate the agreement if the conditions have not been met by 31 December 2026.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Kripos spårar kryptovinster från narkotikabrott i operation Hubris 6
item.description:
Kripos, including the National Cybercrime Centre (NC3), traced cash that had been exchanged into cryptocurrency as part of operation Hubris 6, TV 2 reports, citing an Oslo District Court judgment from March 2026. As reported by TV 2, the court convicted five men of serious drug offences; the longest sentence was 16 years and 3 months, and the judgment has been appealed. According to the judgment as reported by TV 2, a courier received cash and exchanged it into the cryptocurrency Tether. Kripos says the exchanges, over about four months in 2024, came to more than 70 million Norwegian kroner, and that more than 23 million Norwegian kroner has been frozen.

Källa: TV 2

item.title: Børsen: intresset för Danske Banks och Nordeas kryptoprodukter har varit extremt begränsat
item.description:
According to Børsen, customer interest in crypto investment products at Danske Bank and Nordea has been extremely limited, even though the banks have spoken of strong interest. A Danmarks Nationalbank staff paper dated 15 April 2026, not a new November survey, found that household exposure to crypto assets in Denmark remains low, and noted that the two banks now offer crypto exchange-traded products on their platforms. Danske Bank said on 11 February 2026 that customers on its trading platform can invest in selected ETPs that track bitcoin and ethereum.

Källa: Børsen

item.title: USA går vidare för att beslagta eller frysa mer än 1,2 miljarder dollar stulna i Binance-hackningen
item.description:
The US Department of Justice said on 12 November 2026 that a court has authorised the seizure or freezing of more than 1.2 billion US dollars in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance. More than 2.7 billion dollars have already been frozen. The FBI attributes the theft to the North Korean group it calls TraderTraitor. The same DOJ release also covers a separate scheme, FaceStealer, in which fake video meetings were used to steal more than 400 million dollars over 18 months; that is not a new Binance theft. In a later development reported by Realtid, citing The Block and Reuters, the Abu Dhabi Global Market court has issued a worldwide freeze of up to 6.5 billion US dollars, covering about 26,000 wallet addresses, and has ordered 18 companies, including Circle and World Liberty Financial, to maintain the freeze; according to those reports, none of the 18 companies is accused of wrongdoing. That ADGM ruling is a separate court order from the US seizure, with different amounts and jurisdictions. The reports, which cite the blockchain analytics firm Elliptic, say a further hearing is due on 1 December.

Källa: VG

item.title: Pokerligans nya giv
item.description:
According to Flamman's own investigation, companies and people around Valuno's former chief executive, Daniel Sonesson, have continued to operate in payments, including services used by online casinos. Sweden's Economic Crime Authority has charged Sonesson with aggravated insider trading, and he denies wrongdoing, according to Svenska Dagbladet. The company and person links Flamman reports are the paper's own findings.

Källa: Flamman

item.title: Yle: färre än en av sex finska kryptoaktörer deklarerar sina affärer
item.description:
Yle reports that the Finnish tax office says fewer than one in six crypto traders in Finland declare their trades. That share has not been confirmed in the tax authority's published notes on the new reporting duty. From next year the authority is due to receive data from Finnish and foreign crypto-asset service providers, according to Vero.fi.

Källa: Yle Uutiset

item.title: Axiology får utökad MiFID-tillstånd för tokeniserade tillgångar
item.description:
Lithuania's Axiology has received an expanded MiFID authorisation from the Bank of Lithuania (Lietuvos bankas) covering the reception, transmission and execution of client orders, according to the company as reported by Kaupr. The firm says the change lets institutions subscribe and redeem units in tokenised money-market funds directly through it. Axiology already operates under the EU DLT Pilot Regime.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Nya uppgifter om jättestölden: Ensam datadetektiv bakom upptäckt
item.description:
Crédit Mutuel Arkéa has confirmed a cyberattack carried out through a service provider's platform, and said the funds may then have been converted into cryptocurrency, according to the bank's statement of 4 November 2026. Blockchain investigator ZachXBT first flagged large unauthorised withdrawals from crypto-exchange accounts, Realtid reports, citing figures of about 133 million US dollars; the bank has not confirmed that amount and said it could only validate the order of magnitude.

Källa: Realtid

item.title: Norska regeringen planerar tillståndsprövning för datacenter; kryptoverksamhet räknas inte som samhällsnyttig
item.description:
The Norwegian government will start work on a licensing scheme for data centres, according to a 9 November 2026 press release from the Ministry of Digitalisation and Public Governance and the Ministry of Energy. Facilities used for crypto activity will not be treated as socially beneficial, the government said. It aims to present the main principles in the autumn of 2027. Statnett has separately paused new grid reservations for data centres.

Källa: Shifter

item.title: NBX och Aprikos Venture ansöker i Pakistan om godkännande för börsen Nayapaisa
item.description:
Norwegian Block Exchange (NBX) and Aprikos Venture have signed a joint venture for a planned Pakistan crypto exchange, Nayapaisa, and have applied to the Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority for a No Objection Certificate, according to the companies as reported by Kaupr. The application is the first step in a licensing process, and the exchange will not serve customers until both the certificate and a licence are granted. The plan is to offer deposits and withdrawals in Pakistani rupees through licensed Pakistani banks.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Meta och Palantir säger nej till aktietokenisering – 67 bolag hoppar OKXICE
item.description:
OKXICE's public notice dated 5 November 2026 lists Notices of Issuer Objection from 67 issuers, including Meta Platforms and Palantir Technologies, according to the document published by OKXICE. The notice follows earlier reporting that disclosed objections had risen to 56 companies. Kryptovalutaguiden covered the update.

Källa: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: Binances finanschef Kaiser Ng avgår; Justin Yek tar över
item.description:
Binance co-founder and co-chief executive Yi He said Kaiser Ng is leaving as chief financial officer after more than five years to pursue a new venture, with a transition plan that has been under way for about six months, according to The Block and The Globe and Mail. Justin Yek, previously vice-president of finance at Airwallex, is taking over as CFO. The announcement came days after the late-October theft from Binance; Yi He did not say the departure was caused by the incident.

Källa: E24

item.title: OFAC utpekar åtta kanadensiska valutaväxlare för Iran-kopplad digital tillgångsverksamhet
item.description:
The U.S. Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control designated eight Canadian money services businesses on 6 November 2026 for helping move value involving Iran and related sanctioned actors through digital assets, according to the Treasury press release. OFAC said some of the firms also handled digital-asset transfers linked to Canadian drug trafficker Ryan Wedding. The designations are part of what Treasury calls Operation Economic Outcast.

Källa: Finansavisen

item.title: Safello rapporterar rörelseresultat på 0,8 miljoner kronor i tredje kvartalet
item.description:
Safello reported third-quarter operating profit of SEK 0.8 million, according to its figures reported by Kaupr. Revenue fell 41 percent to SEK 98.4 million; the company reported a gross margin of 8.8 percent.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Så utnyttjades kändisarna i kryptobluff kopplad till Ulricehamn
item.description:
Ulricehamns Tidning reports that SEK 1.5 million in cryptocurrency was transferred through an intermediary in a romance scam. The publicly accessible excerpt does not establish whether anyone has been charged or convicted.

Källa: Ulricehamns Tidning

item.title: Norges Bank ser inget behov av digitala centralbankspengar för allmänheten nu
item.description:
Norges Bank sees no current need for retail digital central bank money but wants to be ready if that changes, Torbjørn Hægeland told a conference, according to Kaupr. He said a digital euro would not by itself determine Norway's decision.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Norges Bank-företrädare uppmanar bankerna att utveckla en tokeniseringsstrategi
item.description:
Banks should prepare a tokenisation strategy, Norges Bank's Torbjørn Hægeland said at a conference, according to Kaupr. He said important settlements should use central bank money, including transactions on tokenised platforms.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Handeln hos Firi mer än fördubblades dagen efter Binance-hackingen, enligt E24
item.description:
The Norwegian crypto exchange Firi recorded 19.8 million kroner in crypto trading the day after the Binance hack — more than double a typical day — according to figures Firi shared with E24. Activity stayed high over the weekend at 15.4 million kroner, 50 percent above the next-busiest weekend so far this year, chief executive Thuc Hoang told E24. Hoang says it is too early to know whether customers are permanently moving funds from foreign exchanges.

Källa: E24

item.title: Virtune noterar AI-kryptoindex-ETP på Nasdaq Stockholm och Xetra
item.description:
Nordic ETP issuer Virtune listed its Virtune AI Crypto Index ETP on 3 November 2026 under the tickers VIRAI on Nasdaq Stockholm and VRTI on Deutsche Börse Xetra, according to Kaupr. The product tracks an index of 13 crypto assets linked to what the industry calls the agent economy. In an interview with Kaupr, Virtune chief sales officer Andreas Severin said the listing reflects the company's view that software agents using blockchain services are becoming a growth driver alongside tokenisation.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Elon Musk stoppar Tesla och SpaceX från tokeniserade aktier
item.description:
Tesla, SpaceX, Amazon, Netflix, SoFi and Lam Research are among the companies that have objected to their shares being offered as tokens on OKXICE. According to CoinDesk, Decrypt and CoinMarketCap, the number of disclosed objections rose from 50 in a notice on 30 October to 56 in a notice on 2 November. By CoinDesk's tally, 49 of 62 companies have objected.

Källa: Kryptovalutaguiden

item.title: Binance: Hackare använde falska jobbintervjuer och ett internt AI-verktyg
item.description:
According to a Binance post on X on 3 November, the attackers behind the recent theft approached an engineer in September with a fake job interview and got him to download a "task" containing malware. Binance says the attackers then used his laptop and misused an internal AI tool to take over the computers of two other engineers. DR reports that Binance has covered 98 percent of the losses; on 31 October Binance said about 90 percent had been replaced.

Källa: DR

item.title: Hyperliquids grundare vill nå amerikanska handlare via reglerade partner
item.description:
Hyperliquid had revenue of 713 million US dollars over the past 12 months, Investornytt reports, citing Bloomberg Businessweek. Founder Jeff Yan wants to reach US traders through regulated partners, while CME and ICE have pressed regulators about such platforms; ICE has itself invested in Trade.xyz. According to Event Horizon Labs, fewer than one in four accounts on the platform are profitable.

Källa: Investornytt

item.title: Firi förlänger permitteringarna till mars 2027 och anställer ny produktchef
item.description:
The Norwegian crypto exchange Firi says the temporary lay-offs it announced in August will last until the end of March 2027, the maximum of 26 weeks allowed under Norwegian rules, chief executive Thuc Hoang told Kaupr. Hoang says trading activity in 2026 has been lower than the company had planned for. Firi has hired Dino Cehajic, previously at Eika, as chief product officer, and according to Kaupr three key employees have left for other jobs since September.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Två tidigare Valuno-chefer åtalade för grovt insiderbrott
item.description:
Sweden's Economic Crime Authority has charged Valuno Group's former chief executive and a former finance director with aggravated insider trading, according to Kaupr and Kryptovalutaguiden. According to the prosecutor, the two learned on 3 July 2025 that Finansinspektionen had refused the subsidiary QB Europe a MiCA licence and sold large parts of their shares before the decision was made public on 4 July, after which the share price fell about 33 percent. Valuno says it is assisting the legal process as needed; no one has been convicted. The charged former chief executive is also a former leader of Medborgerlig Samling and denies wrongdoing, according to SvD; the case is Stockholm District Court B 16085-26.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: NBX har tagit in minst 34 miljoner norska kronor från LDA Capital, enligt Kauprs sammanräkning
item.description:
The Norwegian crypto exchange NBX has raised at least 34 million Norwegian kroner from the US investor LDA Capital through ten share issues since 2022, according to Kaupr's tally of the company's stock exchange announcements; the latest, closed on 3 November 2026, raised 6.8 million kroner at 0.47 kroner per share. According to NBX's announcements, the money has funded bitcoin purchases and the capital requirements for its e-money licence and its MiCA licence. Under the agreement, NBX decides when to draw on the facility.

Källa: Kaupr

item.title: Nordkorea avvisar FBI:s uppgift om Binance-attacken
item.description:
North Korea has rejected the FBI's statement that North Korean hackers were behind the theft from Binance, calling it an 'absurd fabrication' in a statement by Kim Yo-jong carried by the state news agency KCNA, according to Yonhap and Bloomberg. The statement calls the attribution a political provocation and suggests it could affect dialogue between North Korea and the United States. The FBI said on 31 October that North Korea's TraderTraitor was responsible and published addresses linked to the stolen funds; the denial is North Korea's position, not a new finding.

Källa: Aftenposten

item.title: Binance redovisar nettoutflöde på omkring 3,64 miljarder dollar efter att uttagen öppnat igen
item.description:
According to Binance, customers withdrew a net of about 3.64 billion US dollars between 07:00 and 16:30 CET on 1 November 2026, after the exchange reopened withdrawals following the hack: about 4.65 billion went out and 1.01 billion came in. Binance says this equals about 2.1 percent of its 171 billion dollars in assets and that withdrawals are levelling off. According to CNBC, the stablecoin issuer Circle has now frozen more than 1.1 billion USDC. The analytics service DefiLlama reports higher outflow figures, which Binance disputes because they do not account for its own transfers to new wallets.

Källa: E24
